categoryRules.evidence: Met department Musical Instruments, or a source classification/objectName that names an instrument
source classification/objectName/medium names an astrolabe, celestial globe, armillary sphere, sundial or astronomical instrument
source classification/objectName names a game, game board, chess piece, die, playing card or toy

a painting/print/drawing/photograph whose source title, object name or tags name a landscape, view, coast, garden or cityscape

source classification/objectName names furniture, a clock/watch or a designed household/lighting object
source classification/objectName names a domestic vessel, container or utensil (bowl, plate, cup, jar, bottle, vessel, box, basket)
source classification/objectName names a weapon, armor, tool or implement (arrow, sword, dagger, helmet, shield, sickle, hammer, chisel, adze)

selectionRequires: primaryImage and primaryImageSmall are https URLs on images.metmuseum.org
a non-empty culture or country label
country/culture resolves to a documented continent (unmapped labels are rejected, not guessed)
definitionOfDoneForData.englishCopy: title.en is the institution's title verbatim (also copied to title.original with originalLanguage 'en'); the English summary is a deterministic template over documented fields (object name, place, date, medium).
definitionOfDoneForData.translation: title.ar/de and summary.ar/de are machine translations produced by scripts/culture/translate.mjs (DeepSeek, JSON batches) and the record provenance is machine-translated; no data record claims institutional wording for translated copy.
definitionOfDoneForData.weight: 0.4 base + 0.15 date + 0.10 culture&country + 0.10 medium + 0.10 source tags + 0.15 Met isHighlight (curatorial flag). Documented richness only; never rarity.
